description.value:
“A Front-Row Seat for the next episode. The best view in the house.” (Open 4, rival max 8)

The winner sits out the next episode in the Booth's guest box, completely safe. The Booth is lit, full of monitors, and empty except for a single mannequin slumped in the director's chair with its eyes dark. Whenever Celmak speaks, its eyes glow and its head turns. A DC 20 Perception check shows a thick data cable running from its spine into the floor.
